records.title: 10-K
records.text: Consolidated total revenues in 2022 increased $164.5 million, or 29%, from 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Backlog reported by our Offshore/Manufactured Products segment increased to $308 million as of December 31, 2022 from $260 million as of December 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Backlog in our Offshore/Manufactured Products segment totaled $308 million as of December 31, 2022 compared to $260 million as of December 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Demand for oil and natural gas has increased steadily from the lows experienced in 2020 as the impact of the global response to the COVID-19 pandemic continues to wane, with commodity prices also driven by declines in crude oil supplies, concerns over sanctions resulting from the Russian invasion of Ukraine and slower crude oil production growth due to reduced investments by operators globally in recent years.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Capital investment by our customers temporarily declined due to these factors and the desire to generate sustainable cash flows.
